file_impact.reason: Add a structural watchdog-timeout predicate keyed on the rc run_git_bounded already sets, so a timeout is a distinguishable condition rather than prose another function greps. Purely additive: no existing marker tuple, bucket or predicate changes, so push/fetch retry behaviour is untouched.

Consult the new predicate in _union_merge and log a warning naming the timeout, bound and operation instead of 'could not auto-merge ... run rebar fsck-recover'. Also stop bounding the local merge/reset mutations at the network fetch bound (_GIT_TIMEOUT), which is O(index entries) work misjudged by a stuck-remote bound.

Regression tests on the existing sync._git / sync.run_git seams: a timed-out merge reports the timeout and not the conflict text; a genuine conflict still takes the unchanged recovery-then-abort path; the timeout is attempted exactly once (no retry); and the new predicate's true/false cases.
